data.title: Personal liability insurance policy update (Nachtrag Nr. 1)
data.summary: Muster Versicherung AG sent an updated policy for your personal liability insurance (Privat-Haftpflicht) after your change of address and bank details. The annual premium of €59.90 will be debited on 1 December 2026.
data.explanation: This is an updated insurance policy confirming your new address and bank account. It replaces the policy of 24 November 2023. The premium of €59.90 is collected yearly by direct debit, next on 1 December 2026, so make sure your account has enough money. The contract renews by one year each time unless you cancel in text form at least three months before the end of the insurance year (30 November). Check that all details are correct and keep the document.
data.tax_note: Liability insurance contributions may be deductible as other insurance expenses (Vorsorgeaufwendungen) in your tax return.
